content:
## Project Overview
React Native (Expo) tree-audit app. Field users capture trees, upload full audit photos, work assigned tasks, and review map/history. Workspace: `d:/5eliment/app/treeapp`. Map UI: tree detail overlay must not cover map controls; task progress is an approved tree count. Capture page must auto-detect and save a scientific name (Guava = `Psidium guajava`). After Capture a Tree restyle, the capture field stays empty when the name is stored rather than in the species list. Card-front scientific name was written then banned; removal not written. Planting-card gap and TreeDetail accordion-closed requests are unfixed. Stated DB defect: a saved audit is stored as a planting, so the admin web planting approve/reject tabs show it; it must be stored via db/api as an audit; after save it must leave Assigned and show on Completed. Auto-redirect onto Completed was also called a problem. User then said that understanding is correct but the task page’s tasks will not work the flow. Later note (typos kept): “this audit page shoe planting to replce audit according.” A display-only tag edit was written on EditTreeScreen so an audit shows `Audit ${auditRound}` instead of `eventType`. Storage, submit payload, and the completed-tab redirect were not changed by that edit. An interrupted 4:05 PM completion claimed the phone no longer inserts the next audit, the same tasks row is stored completed as an audit, and a leftover later open audit row is deleted; no write result then. User then said that only worked once, the next audit is still created, and the Assigned-tab audit card shows only a Save Audit button and not the other tab content in the card. 4:16–4:22 restated that card bug in conflicting ways and only read files. At 4:23 PM a repo search showed the on-disk `insertNextAuditTask` path selects an existing row and comments that the phone does not create the next audit; a later block still deletes open tasks with a higher `audit_round`. At 4:25 PM the later-round delete block was rewritten and confirmed modified; a TreeCard tab-visibility edit failed with no match. At 4:26:05 PM the same TreeCard Row-4 edit was retried and returned `operation: modified`. At 4:27 PM a search of that file and `tsc` both returned; the reply after those results was rejected for no tool. No further write.

## Completed Work
- Crop/confirm removed so audit photos upload in full. Profile projects dropdown and app info cleanup. Clear seen notifications; hide hourly email. Hide Land Boundary Locked card after fencing. Capture a Tree opens the assigned tab; progress is an approved tree count that opens the approved tab. HomeScreen Capture a Tree restyle: white dashboard card, green top edge, pale leaf tile, dark title, assigned count on the right. Same navigation (`Task`, tab `assigned`). TreeMapScreen: opening a tree’s details hides Mute, current location, and Auto-Zoom Land Fence; they return when the card closes. GPS pill stays top-left. Write confirmed.
- TreeCard: title is species only (`splitLabeledTreeName` on `tree.species`, skip `'Tree Capture'`, else task name/title). Assigned/in-progress ID from `task_code` or first 8 of task id. Photo prefers latest audit front, then task, then tree. Condition only after monitoring round ≥ 1. Completed-with-review_notes shows EDITED `#ea580c`. Approved badge `#ddd6fe`. Audit-card write put scientific name under the tree name; user then banned scientific name on any card front. Removal not written. HistoryScreen written twice so audited trees use the task-page audit card; planted-only stay planting cards. Diffs not returned.
- TreeDetailScreen: three `getSpeciesDefault` edits issued so Guava shows `Psidium guajava`; results not returned. Accordion search: planting details start open (`useState(true)` line 62). No close-by-default edit. Bottom FAB is a detail-screen action, not the Assigned-tab card.
- treeService: `completeTask` import removed (circular). `updateBaselineTree` task close is a local 4-attempt drop (`status`/`completed_at` never dropped; `review_notes: 'edited'` only when `options?.editedAfterReject`). `insertTreeRecord` (`src/services/treeService.ts` 66–115): `NEW_COLUMNS` includes `scientific_name`. Missing-column PostgREST error warns to run `supabase/migrations/001_add_tree_columns.sql` and writes defined non-null `NEW_COLUMNS` into notes as `##META##`. 4:16 PM `.insert(` search: tree_records at 81, 88, 116 and `tree_monitoring_records` at 367. 4:23 search: tasks update loop at 516–518. Not edited through 4:27.
- Five scientific-name edits, all modified, diffs not returned: taskService hydrates `scientific_name` (task field, else row, else notes meta, else null). TreeForm mount effect fills the capture field from the assigned task, local tree, notes meta, then `getSpeciesDefault`, then `fetchTreeById` only if still empty. Effect calls `splitAssignedTreeName` and `trees` while the import is `splitLabeledTreeName`. Submit/`insertTreeRecord` not changed. Write-back completion interrupted and not accepted.
- Dual-tab edits, all three `operation: modified`, new baselines, diffs not returned. On-disk reads after 4:05 show additional comments/logic that were not returned as modification results (see Key Technical Decisions).
  - `src/services/taskService.ts` tree-card merge after `byId`: skip a card whose `taskLinkKeys` are already linked, and skip unless `card.status` is `'assigned'` or `'in_progress'`.
  - `src/screens/Task/TaskScreen.tsx` `keptCompleted`: drop a finished audit (`task_type === 'audit'` or `audit_round > 0`) when an open winner exists for the same tree.
  - `src/services/auditService.ts`: removed `treeUpdates.stage = 'completed'` and `treeUpdates.status = 'completed'`. Keeps `treeUpdates.survey_date = dateStr`.
- Type-check `npx tsc --noEmit --pretty false --skipLibCheck` in `d:/5eliment/app/treeapp`, timeout 90, exit 0, empty output. First accepted result 3:08:12 PM. Same command re-run at 4:27 PM after the 4:25 auditService delete rewrite and the 4:26 TreeCard Row-4 write: exit 0, empty output. Dual-tab and reject-tab `attempt_completion` calls interrupted. Not accepted. No reject-tab edit.
- User defect (typos kept): after audit the card auto-redirects to the completed tab; the audit is stored as a planting so it shows on the admin web planting approve/reject tabs; store it via db/api as an audit; after save remove it from Assigned and show it on Completed. `UpdateTreeScreen` params `treeId`, `treeIdDisplay`, `currentRound` (line 78); no `taskId`. `Task` includes `scientific_name?: string | null` (line 133).
- `completeTask(` in `auditService.ts` (last dedicated call-site read): 515–517 `completeTask(taskId, ..., { editedAfterReject: taskRow.status === 'rejected' })`; 562–564 `finishedIds` `completeTask(id)`; 566–568 `rejectedIds` `completeTask(id, ..., { editedAfterReject: true })`. Both loops warn `[auditService] close task:` on error. 4:23 search did not re-hit those three call lines. The 4:25, 4:26, and 4:27 actions did not touch those calls.
- User (typos kept): “you underatnd is correct but taskpage in task are will not work this flow find problem and solve it.” TaskScreen 100–139 sliced; tsc exit 0. 3:14 PM claim that each tasks row is its own card had no write result. On-disk comment at TaskScreen 401–402 now says that (see below).
- User (typos kept): “this audit page shoe planting to replce audit according.” At 3:15 PM `src/screens/History/EditTreeScreen.tsx` modified. Display-only tag: `isAudit ? `Audit ${auditRound}` : eventType` with `clipboard-outline` vs `leaf`. No change to `eventType` load, `submitAudit` args, `completeTask`, `updateBaselineTree`, or the navigate-to-completed redirect.
- At 4:05:22 PM visible file was `supabase/migrations/001_add_tree_columns.sql`. Assistant `update_todo_list` (all three `[x]`) and `attempt_completion` claimed: saved audit no longer creates the next assigned audit; same tasks row written completed and as an audit; admin approve/reject moves that same row; next round only when an admin assigns it; leftover later open audit row deleted on save; type-check passed. Both tool calls interrupted. No file-modification result and no tsc output. Not accepted. 4:23 on-disk auditService text matches parts of that claim (lookup instead of insert; delete of later open rounds) even though no modification result was returned.
- Task resumed 4:14:57 PM. User (typos kept): “this was work only one time else not work and next audit also create this problem will not solve and assign tab in assign audit card in only show save audit button not show esle tab in card. finde problme and solve it all bug.” No write after that message until 4:25.
- 4:16–4:22: reads only, every following reply rejected for no tool. TreeDetail 1080–1219 and 350–409 are not the list card. TreeCard then only lines 1–80. `.insert(` under `src/services`: 6 hits, none in auditService. Only `createTask(` is `taskService.ts:317` (`tasks` insert). SQL search of `001` had no next-audit function body. UpdateTreeScreen already maps `MONITORING_ROUNDS` into `styles.topTab` at 701–745 and `activeTab === 3` already renders Growth Monitoring / Audit 3 (DBH, height, crown) at 1000–1079. Types 330–359 are the four-round `MONITORING_ROUNDS` array. Diagnoses that the form is missing or hiding round tabs are contradicted by those slices.
- 4:23:52 PM: `list_files` on `supabase` (recursive) and repo search `next audit|audit_round|insert into public.tasks|from\('tasks'\)` in `*.{ts,tsx,js,sql}` — 56 hits. No file modified. Reply after the results rejected: “You did not use a tool in your previous response.”
- 4:25:01 PM: two edits issued. `auditService.ts` modified (new baseline). `TreeCard.tsx` edit failed: no match for the Row-4 condition string. Reply after the tool results was rejected for no tool.
- 4:26:05 PM: the same TreeCard Row-4 edit was retried and returned `<operation>modified</operation>`. Notice: treat the change as the new baseline; do not re-read. Comment is now “Row 4: Audit 1–4 tabs. An assigned audit card always shows them.” Condition is `isAudit && (isAssigned || isRejected || isCompletedAudit || showAuditedApprovedCard)` and no longer requires `computedAuditStatus`. Reply after that result was rejected for no tool. Reminders 1 and 2 remain Completed in the tracker only.
- 4:27 PM: assistant said the Assigned card now keeps the four audit tabs even when the schedule is missing, then searched and type-checked. `search_files` `computedAuditStatus` in `src/components/TreeCard.tsx`: 3 hits (85–87 useMemo, 94 `effectiveDueLabel`, 385–387 Row-4 opener). `tsc` exit 0, empty output. Reply after those results rejected: “You did not use a tool in your previous response.” No file modified at 4:27. The “tabs even when the schedule is missing” sentence is an assistant claim; the search only confirms the gate and the first two lines of the IIFE. Device check of the Assigned card still not returned.

## Key Technical Decisions
- Map chrome hides Mute, current location, and Auto-Zoom Land Fence while a tree details card is open; GPS pill stays top-left. Task progress UI uses approved tree count. Audit photos upload in full.
- Card-face ban: “given image any card not show on front Scientific name.” Removal from TreeCard not written. Capture Scientific name field and TreeDetail profile are separate. History audited trees were written to use the task-page audit card. Planting-card gap between scientific name and assigned date is unedited and conflicts with the front-of-card ban.
- Capture scientific name: user rejected the claim that it already saves. Five edits fill the form from task/tree/notes/`getSpeciesDefault`/`fetchTreeById`. They do not change submit or `insertTreeRecord`. `scientific_name` remains a known insert column; missing-column path stores `##META##` in notes. TreeForm mount effect calls `splitAssignedTreeName`; the export in treeId is `splitLabeledTreeName`. Effect also calls `trees.find`; a `trees` binding was not in a returned slice. Project tsc after those edits, the dual-tab edits, and the TaskScreen slice type-check all exited 0 with empty output. The 3:15 PM tag edit had no tsc of its own; the 4:27 PM tsc (exit 0, empty) is the first type-check after the 4:25 and 4:26 writes and covers the tree as of that moment.
- TreeDetail planting accordion last confirmed source is `useState(true)` at line 62. Bottom action region (1080–1211) is a detail-screen FAB, not the Assigned-tab TreeCard, and does not contain a “Save Audit” button. 4:18 PM flags (350–400): `canStartAudit` is true when `asAuditProfile` or when the task is assigned/in_progress and is an audit. `showAuditProfile` is `audits.length > 0` or `asAuditProfile`. 4:23 adds task-row ranking at 200–217 and round math at 380–384; still the detail screen.
- Circular import: treeService no longer imports `completeTask`. Baseline task close is the local 4-attempt loop (4:23 hit at treeService 516–518: `supabase.from('tasks').update(taskPayload).eq('id', taskId)`). `completeTask` in taskService remains the capture-submit path and the audit-close path. 4:23 shows two 6-attempt task updates in taskService (352–354 and 406–408). At 394–396, when the audit option is set: `updates.event_type = 'audit'` and `if (options.auditRound) updates.audit_round = options.auditRound`. The three auditService task-close sites were last read calling `completeTask` at 515, 562, and 566. The auditService dual-tab edit only stops copying `stage`/`status` `'completed'` onto the tree row.
- Next-audit insert — later reading wins over the earlier “defined ~275, awaited at 363, returns `{ task: data, error }` insert” memory. 4:23 search of current `auditService.ts` (still standing except the delete block rewritten at 4:25; 4:26 and 4:27 did not touch this file):
  - Lines 101–103 and 252–254 still describe `nextRound` / `nextDate` / `nextTask` (“Auto-created task for the next audit (null if skipped/failed)”).
  - Lines 258–260 comment: “The next audit is not created by the phone. An admin assigns that task after approving the round that was just saved. Returning the existing row,”
  - Lines 275–284: `supabase.from('tasks').select('id, status, audit_round, tree_id, tree_record_id').or(\`tree_record_id.eq.${tree.id},tree_id.eq.${tree.id}\`)`, then `match` where `Number(t.audit_round) === round`, return `{ task: match }` (or `{ error }`). This slice is a lookup, not an insert.
  - 4:16 `.insert(` search still found no insert in this file. The only `tasks` insert in the 4:23 hits is `taskService.ts` `createTask` at 318–320 (`.from('tasks').insert({`). Callers of `createTask` were not in the result. User still says the next audit is created after a save (worked only once). The 4:25 write does not stop an insert; it only deletes later open audit rows after a save. 4:27 tsc exit 0 does not prove the insert stopped.
- 4:25 confirmed write replaces the previous 506–513 delete. New baseline in `auditService.ts`: comment says a later save used to insert the next round as a new Assigned task, and every later open audit for this tree is deleted even when this save’s first lookup missed it. `laterColumns` tries `'id, status, audit_round, tree_id, tree_record_id, task_type'`, then without `task_type`, then `'id, status, audit_round, tree_id'`. Each try: `supabase.from('tasks').select(columns).or(orFilter).in('status', ['assigned', 'in_progress']).limit(20)`; first success breaks. `nextRoundIds` skips `task.id === taskId`, keeps rows where `task.task_type === 'audit' || Number(task.audit_round) > 0` AND `Number(task.audit_round) > clampedRound`, then `supabase.from('tasks').delete().in('id', nextRoundIds)` with warn `[auditService] remove next audit task:`. Depends on existing `orFilter`, `taskId`, and `clampedRound` in that function. Does not change the 275–284 lookup, `completeTask` calls, or `createTask`. Unchanged by the 4:26 TreeCard write and the 4:27 search/tsc.
- 4:16–4:22 diagnoses are not source and were contradicted by UpdateTreeScreen already rendering round tabs and Audit 3 fields. The user’s bug is the Assigned-tab card. 4:23 TreeCard hits are only lines 168–185 (round + is-audit flags), not the card body, round-tab strip, or Save Audit button. 4:25 TreeCard edit failed: exact old_string was not in the file. 4:26 retry of that same string succeeded (`operation: modified`). 4:27 search is the later reading of that write and wins over the 4:26 patch summary. On disk at lines 385–387:
  ```
  {isAudit && (isAssigned || isRejected || isCompletedAudit || showAuditedApprovedCard) ? (() => {
    const status = computedAuditStatus;
    const finishedRound = Number(auditRound) || status?.maxRound || status?.completedCount || 1;
  ```
  The `computedAuditStatus` truthiness gate is gone, so an assigned/rejected/completed audit card enters Row 4 even when `computedAuditStatus` is missing. Only three `computedAuditStatus` names remain in the file (definition 85–87, due label 94, this alias 386). The IIFE body after `finishedRound` was not in the search. No device check. Whether the Assigned card still shows only Save Audit is not re-read after this write. 4:27 tsc exit 0, empty.
- Dual-tab diagnosis (assistant, backed by the three writes; user later said the understanding is correct, but the task page will not work this flow): saving an audit marked the tree row completed, then the app rebuilt a second card from that tree. Fixes written: (1) do not append a tree card whose link keys already belong to a task row; (2) do not append a tree card unless status is `'assigned'` or `'in_progress'`; (3) do not keep a finished audit beside an open card for the same tree; (4) do not write the audit result onto the tree row’s `stage`/`status`. Completions that claimed this was fixed were interrupted or rejected. 4:23 TaskScreen 401–402 on disk: “One card per tasks row. An audit and the next audit of the same tree are different rows, so each follows its own database status.” That comment was not in the 100–139 slice and has no modification-tool result; it is current source. The 3:14 one-card claim remains unaccepted as a completion.
- Unaccepted 4:05 PM claim had no write result and no tsc. Parts of it now appear in the 4:23 auditService slices (phone does not create next audit; later open higher-round tasks are deleted). User then said this worked only one time and the next audit is still created. The 4:25 delete rewrite is a real modification of that later-round cleanup only. Reminder 1 showing those lines checked is tracker state, not proof the next audit stopped being created. Reminder 2 marked Completed is tracker state only; the TreeCard tab condition was written at 4:26 and re-read at 4:27, not proven on a device. 4:27 tsc exit 0 is a compile result only.
- Reject-tab note (typos kept): “reject tab aslo shoe audit card.” No reject-tab edit diff. 4:23 TaskScreen 631–636 rewrites a rejected non-audit task into `task_type: 'audit'` with `audit_round: task.audit_round || treeAudits.length || 1` before the card. Not a new write. The 4:26/4:27 Row-4 condition includes `isRejected`.
- User storage defect still has no confirmed db/api write after 3:15: after save, do not auto-redirect onto Completed; store the record as an audit not a planting so admin planting approve/reject does not show it; after save the card leaves Assigned and shows on Completed. EditTreeScreen audit path still last fully read as `submitAudit` then `completeTask` then `updateBaselineTree` with only `survey_date`, then `openTaskTab('completed')` and navigate to Task tab `completed`. `event_type` still loads from `t.event_type` or `'Planting'` and was not in the shown `submitAudit` args. The 3:15 PM edit only changed the tag label. 4:23 EditTreeScreen 295–304 is task matching inside that save path (open/rejected audit task for the same tree and round, else any open audit task for the tree), not a storage-type change. taskService 394 sets `event_type = 'audit'` on a task update when the audit option is present; that is not the tree-record planting insert.
- Assigned-card bug, user wording kept: “assign tab in assign audit card in only show save audit button not show esle tab in card.” On the Assigned tab, the assigned audit card shows only a Save Audit button and does not show the other tab in the card. 4:16 inverted that. 4:19 blamed a missing tab strip on the audit form. 4:22 called it the Assigned audit page hiding the other round tabs. None of those is a user correction. UpdateTreeScreen’s form tabs are a different surface and already render. Last confirmed TreeCard write before 4:26 still had the scientific-name-on-front line that the user banned, with removal not written. 4:26 wrote the Row-4 gate so an assigned audit (`isAudit && isAssigned`, among other statuses) enters the Audit 1–4 tab block without requiring `computedAuditStatus`. 4:27 confirms that gate and `finishedRound` via a local `status` alias with optional chaining. Body of that block, any Save Audit control, and a device check were not returned.
- EditTreeScreen is the audit save form. Tag display edited at 3:15 PM. `isAudit = Number(auditRound) > 0`. Route params include `treeId`, `taskId`, `rejectionNotes`, `auditRound`. Header title is `AUDIT ${auditRound} DETAILS` when `isAudit`, else `EDIT TREE DETAILS`. Save label is `Save Audit` vs `Save & Resubmit for Review`. Style name remains `plantingTag` / `plantingTagText`. Auto-redirect the user called a problem is still the client navigation at lines 328–333; TaskScreen lines 100–102 clear it with `openTaskTab(null)`. Neither block was in a later confirmed edit.
- TaskScreen hold window still stands unless a later unread edit overlaps it: during the hold after an audit save, a store task already `'completed'` must not be overwritten by a stale DB `'assigned'`/`'in_progress'`. `isHolding` is `Date.now() < holdCompletedUntil.current` OR `pendingTaskTab === 'completed'`. The `keptCompleted` filter is an additional client-side drop, not a database write. Date grouping in the 100–139 slice, not edited: assigned lists key off `due_date` then `created_at`; other tabs key off `reviewed_at` then `completed_at` then `created_at`. `filterByDate` is a no-op when `selectedDate === 'all'`.
- `fetchAgentTasks` still maps `scientific_name: row.scientific_name || row.scientific || null` before hydrate. Column loop tries `assignee_id`, `user_id`, `assigned_to`, `agent_id`. Then `fetchAssignedTreeTasks` appends only unlinked cards that are also assigned or in progress. 4:23 taskService 18–20: a row is not a planting when `task_type`/`event_type`/`type` is `audit` or `audit_round > 0`; empty/`planting`/`capture`/`task` returns true. Lines 69–71: `locked === true` becomes `'approved'` only when the row is not an audit.
- `UpdateTreeScreen` is opened with `treeId`, `treeIdDisplay`, and `currentRound` only. 4:23 lines 617–621 match an assigned/in_progress audit task for the tree whose `audit_round` equals `activeTab` or is empty. Save / `submitAudit` / next-audit insert were not in the 1–80 slice, the 4:19 search hits, the 1000–1079 slice, or this 617–621 hit.

## Relevant Files & Code
- `src/services/auditService.ts` — last confirmed modification 4:25 PM (`operation: modified`). Still an open tab at 4:27; not edited at 4:26 or 4:27. Dual-tab edit still stands (no `treeUpdates.stage`/`status` `'completed'`). 4:23 lookup still stands: comment at 258–260 says the phone does not create the next audit and an admin assigns it after approving the saved round; 275–284 selects existing tasks for the tree and returns the row whose `audit_round` equals `round`. Return-type comment at 253 still says “Auto-created task for the next audit.” New delete baseline (replaces the 506–513 `openTasks` filter):
  ```
  const laterColumns = [
    'id, status, audit_round, tree_id, tree_record_id, task_type',
    'id, status, audit_round, tree_id, tree_record_id',
    'id, status, audit_round, tree_id',
  ];
  let laterTasks: any[] = [];
  for (const columns of laterColumns) {
    const res = await supabase.from('tasks').select(columns).or(orFilter)
      .in('status', ['assigned', 'in_progress']).limit(20);
    if (!res.error) { laterTasks = (res.data ?? []) as any[]; break; }
  }
  const nextRoundIds = laterTasks.filter((task: any) => {
    if (taskId && task.id === taskId) return false;
    const isAuditTask = task.task_type === 'audit' || Number(task.audit_round) > 0;
    return isAuditTask && Number(task.audit_round) > clampedRound;
  }).map((task: any) => task.id);
  if (nextRoundIds.length > 0) {
    const removed = await supabase.from('tasks').delete().in('id', nextRoundIds);
    if (removed.error) console.warn('[auditService] remove next audit task:', removed.error.message);
  }
  ```
  Lines 430–431, 452–461 select tasks with fallback column lists. Lines 473–475 skip the current `taskId` and keep rows with no round or `taskRound === clampedRound`. Three `completeTask(` calls were last read at 515, 562, 566 and were not in the 4:25, 4:26, or 4:27 actions. No `.insert(` hit in this file at 4:16 or 4:23. Included in the 4:27 tsc (exit 0, empty); not re-read then.
- `src/components/TreeCard.tsx` — last confirmed modification 4:26:05 PM (`operation: modified`). Visible file at 4:27. Scientific name on the audit card was written, then banned on any card front. Removal not written. 4:25 edit of this same string failed (no match). 4:26 retry matched. 4:27 search is the later reading. 4:16 slice 1–80 still stands except where the Row-4 edit overlaps: props include `auditRound`, `audits`, `auditStatus`, `actionLabel`, `actionIcon`, `actionVariant` (`'start' | 'update' | 'audit'`), `onAction`, `onPress`. Status colors: assigned/in_progress `#1a5c2a`, completed `#16a34a`, approved `#7c3aed`, rejected `#ef4444`. `effectiveStatus` starts at line 78. 4:23 hits 168–185, not a write: `auditRound = auditRoundProp ?? task?.audit_round`; treated as audit when `task?.task_type === 'audit'` or `task?.audit_round` or `actionVariant === 'audit'`. 4:27 `computedAuditStatus` hits:
  ```
  85 |   // Compute audit status & due label for approved trees
  86 |   const computedAuditStatus = useMemo(() => {
  87 |     if (auditStatusProp) return auditStatusProp;
  94 |   const effectiveDueLabel = dueLabelProp || (computedAuditStatus ? getDueLabel(computedAuditStatus) : null);
  385 |           {isAudit && (isAssigned || isRejected || isCompletedAudit || showAuditedApprovedCard) ? (() => {
  386 |             const status = computedAuditStatus;
  387 |             const finishedRound = Number(auditRound) || status?.maxRound || status?.completedCount || 1;
  ```
  Replaces the old gate that also required `computedAuditStatus` and used `computedAuditStatus.maxRound` / `.completedCount` without `?.`. The 4:26 summary that wrote optional chaining directly on `computedAuditStatus` is superseded by this `status` alias. The IIFE body after `finishedRound` was not returned. Round-tab markup and any Save Audit button still not in a returned slice. 4:27 tsc exit 0, empty.
- `src/screens/History/EditTreeScreen.tsx` — last confirmed modification 3:15 PM, tag only. When `isAudit`, icon `clipboard-outline` and text `` `Audit ${auditRound}` ``; else leaf and `{eventType}`. No confirmed edit after 3:15. Audit branch of `handleSave` (last full read 208–339) calls `submitAudit` then `completeTask` then `updateBaselineTree(treeId, { survey_date: actionDate })` then forces the completed tab. Non-audit path uses `updateBaselineTree(treeId, updates, taskId, ...)` with no `event_type`. `eventType` load remains `t.event_type` or `'Planting'` (line 127). 4:21 PM slice 618–697 is StyleSheet only (`container` `#f0f4f1`; `photoSection` `#0D1A17`; `plantingTag` `#E5F6EA` / `#1a5c2a`). 4:23 hit 295–304, not a write: finds a task that is assigned, in_progress, or rejected, is an audit (`task_type === 'audit'` or `audit_round`), matches `tree_record_id` or `tree_id`, and `Number(audit_round) === round` or has no round; fallback is any assigned/in_progress audit task for that tree.
